china-1929-30:p1107_1.rationale: Textual list of bureaux of the Army Reorganization Commission, covering army, gendarmerie, police plans, munitions and military land cultivation; no quantities. The army tag fits as the principal subject.

china-1929-30:p1110_1.rationale: Divisional organization of the First Army Group, with officer and men strengths per unit, so the table is statistical.

china-1929-30:p1110_2.rationale: Outline of the organization of an infantry division and its regiment. Content is textual unit structure; the counts of units are incidental.

china-1929-30:p1111_1.rationale: Strength of an infantry division: officers, men, horses, rifles, mortars, machine guns, field guns and wagons.
review_questions: Is a tag for military equipment or force strength needed? The existing arms-and-arsenals tag concerns production and stocks of weapons, so none was assigned beyond army.

china-1929-30:p1111_2.rationale: List of reorganized divisions with commanders' names and army groups; textual roster with ordinal numbering only.

china-1929-30:p1112_1.rationale: List of units pending reorganization with commanders and groups. It also includes quantities of troops and units (for example 20,000 men, 180,000 men, 6 divisions), so it is a mixed table and counts as statistical.

china-1929-30:p1114_1.rationale: Roster of Mukden Army brigades with type, commander and organization status; textual, with numbering only.

china-1929-30:p1114_2.rationale: List of Heilungkiang Army brigades and their commanders; a textual roster.

china-1929-30:p1115_1.rationale: List of Kirin Army units; textual, with numbering only.

china-1929-30:p1115_2.rationale: List of Kwangtung and Kwangsi divisions and their commanders; a textual roster.
